# range specifier
flask>=2.0
# no specifier at all
requests
# compound specifier (comma-joined)
weird==1.0,!=1.0.1
# PEP 440 compatible-release wildcard — a range, not one exact version
wildcard-pkg==1.2.*
# pure option line — not a dependency, must be skipped entirely
--index-url https://example.test/simple
# -r/--requirement include — must be reported as an unaudited coverage gap,
# not silently skipped (an include-only manifest must not read as "clean")
-r other.txt
# editable/VCS install — no exact version, must still be reported (not silently dropped)
-e git+https://example.test/repo.git#egg=editable-pkg
